t: Portable electric fine spray system for quickly and easily applying solvent or water-based fence paint, oil, stain, varnish, wood preservatives and treatments. Extra fine atomisation, for uniform paint coverage with a single coat. Fully adjustable paint volume for control based on the size of the object being sprayed and your working speed. Air jacket surrounds the spray jet to minimize overspray. Detachable gun for quick, easy changes to attachments, paints and refilling or cleaning the gun. Not suitable for thicker paints such as emulsion or masonry paints. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Supplied in Kerbside Recyclable Card/Paper Packaging
